result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban intersection with commercial and residential mixed-use buildings. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the pedestrian infrastructure is degraded with faded crosswalk markings and poor pavement quality.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: The asphalt is cracked and patched, creating uneven surfaces that can be a trip hazard or cause vehicle instability.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walk/don't-walk signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The environment features a marked zebra crosswalk at a signalized intersection, but the roadway pavement is significantly degraded. The sidewalk is heavily obstructed by commercial stalls and awnings, which may force pedestrians into the roadway or limit accessibility.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven surfaces within the crosswalk area create tripping hazards.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Commercial stalls and merchandise under the awning occupy most of the sidewalk width.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the building frontage

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway and crosswalk to provide a smooth, level walking surface.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to clarify right-of-way.

result.summary: The image shows a commercial intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and faded crosswalk markings. However, the environment is degraded with poor pavement quality, significant overhead wire clutter, and a lack of dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement in the roadway and crossing area creates potential trip hazards and uneven surfaces for mobility devices.

hazards.name: Visual Clutter
hazards.description: Extensive overhead wiring and multiple signs may distract drivers from seeing pedestrians at the intersection.

interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk in a commercial area. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the roadway surface is in poor condition and the wide crossing lacks physical protection or refuge for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven patching in the roadway and crosswalk area can cause tripping hazards or vehicle instability.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground across the intersection

hazards.name: Wide unprotected crossing
hazards.description: The crossing distance is relatively long without any physical refuge or curb extensions to reduce exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and smooth the roadway surface to eliminate tripping hazards and improve the integrity of the crosswalk markings.
